evals.name: 01-door-controller-create
evals.expected_output: State and sequence diagrams (directives), versioned _v1, in diagrams/; jam drawn as a suggestion/assumption, not invented behaviour; record file with full trace; all diagrams pass the Mermaid 12.1 check.

evals.name: 02-purchase-approval-create
evals.prompt: Can you draw this purchase approval procedure (specs/purchase-approval.md)? I mainly want to see who does what.
evals.expected_output: A swimlane diagram with lanes Employee, Team lead, Finance, Purchasing (and possibly finance manager), the 5,000 euro decision, escalation; no versioning; default folder specs/diagrams.

evals.name: 03-sensor-link-create
evals.prompt: Visualize specs/sensor-link-protocol.md. I want to see the frame layout and the message exchange when a node joins and sends data.
evals.expected_output: A packet diagram with contiguous fields (4-byte payload example, 2-byte CRC) and a sequence diagram with HELLO retries, DATA/DATA_ACK, NACK repeat; autonumber.

evals.name: 04-door-controller-rework
evals.prompt: I commented on the diagrams in the viewer and pressed Save. Please process my comments.
evals.expected_output: Text copy with [+] additions (jam behaviour, doorway check) and [?] open points (how the doorway is checked); v2 state and sequence diagrams as a local change (ids kept), self-test as a composite state, sequence error fixed, watchdog question answered; comments file deleted; learning notes written.
